chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims going up to Jerusalem. A psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Lord, I'm
not proud or arrogant. I don't worry about things that are beyond me, matters that are far beyond my experience.

On the
contrary, I have chosen to be calm and quiet, like a weaned child with its mother. I am like a weaned child with its mother.

Israel, hope
in the Lord, now and forever!
